data.gender_notes: Azeemah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who is great, majestic, noble, and dignified. The name Azeemah carries the meaning “Great, majestic, noble, dignified” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Azeemah usually hope their child will grow to embody great, majestic, noble, dignified and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Azeemah total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Azeemah holds significant meaning in Islamic culture. In the Arabic language, the word "Azeem" signifies greatness, majesty, and nobility. This name was often given to girls whom their parents considered to be born with innate greatness and dignity. This name not only reminded the girl of her worth but also encouraged her to live up to these noble qualities. In traditional Islamic society, women were expected to uphold high moral and social standards. The name Azeemah further reinforced these expectations and proudly displayed the family’s belief in their daughter’s capacity to achieve great things.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual realm, the name Azeemah represents the essence of a noble soul. This greatness is not limited to worldly possessions or earthly achievements but extends to possessing a pure and virtuous character pleasing to Allah. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) said, "Allah is pleased with the servant as long as the servant is satisfied with what Allah has given." This spiritual significance of the name Azeemah serves as a constant reminder for the individual to strive for inner peace and contentment, continuously working on their character and following Allah's guidance in pursuit of outer success. This name is often a source of inspiration for those who bear it, gently guiding them towards a life filled with spiritual growth and inner transformation.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Great, majestic, noble, dignified" symbolizes The one who is great, majestic, noble, and dignified. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Azeemah serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of great, majestic, noble, dignified.

historical_references.context: Azeemah was a prominent female companion of the Prophet Muhammad and is mentioned in various Hadiths.
